data.title: School entry health examination for Paula on 2 April 2025
data.summary: The public health office (Gesundheitsamt) of Landkreis Beispielstedt invites Paula to her school entry examination (Schuleingangsuntersuchung) on 2 April 2025 at 08:40. The examination is free.
data.explanation: Paula starts school in summer 2025, so the health office invites you both to a routine school entry examination. Bring the yellow children's examination booklet, the vaccination record and, if she has them, glasses or hearing aids. It takes about an hour and costs nothing. If the date doesn't suit you, call the office on 05141 916-530.
